user_journeys.description: Start a new digital mortgage application process by navigating to the external FormTitan application.
user_journeys.business_value: Customer acquisition and digital onboarding for mortgage loans.
user_journeys.user_persona: Prospective home buyer or current homeowner seeking refinancing

proposed_scenarios.description: Attempt to start the digital mortgage application. The flow is partial because the expected external redirect did not occur.
proposed_scenarios.workflow_narrative: The user navigates to the Leumi mortgage homepage and clicks the 'בואו נתחיל' (Let's start) button. The agent expected to be redirected to an external FormTitan application but was instead routed to an internal minisite page, blocking further progress.
playwright_implementation_guidance: Ensure to handle potential redirects after clicking the start button.
Add an assertion to verify the resulting URL. In this partial flow, it lands on /minisite/mortgage instead of the expected external app.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify the entry point for the digital mortgage application is functional.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a prospective borrower, I want to click the start button so that I can begin my digital mortgage application.

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Let's start' button to initiate the application

expected_results: User is able to click the start button
Application navigates to the next step (currently an internal minisite instead of external app)
edge_cases_to_test: Broken link or missing redirect configuration
